cards.text: Friend, the man everybody went out to the Jordan River to see, John the Baptist, has just been arrested. After that, Jesus steps up. He starts proclaiming the gospel of God.

cards.question: After John the Baptist is arrested, where does Jesus go to proclaim the gospel of God?

cards.text: Jesus opens with this: "The time is fulfilled." That's the oven timer going DING, and EVERYBODY in the kitchen looks up at once.

cards.question: In Galilee, Jesus says the kingdom of God is near.
Jesus calls out what to do now that the kingdom of God is near: repent and ___ in the gospel.

cards.text: Now Jesus is walking beside the Sea of Galilee. He sees two brothers, Simon and Andrew, hard at work.

cards.question: When Jesus sees Simon and his brother Andrew by the Sea of Galilee, what are they doing?

answers.text: Casting a net into the sea
Building a boat on the shore

cards.text: Jesus says, "Come, follow Me." Then He describes their new job with a picture straight out of their old one. No orientation binder, no training video, just one sentence.

cards.question: Jesus tells the fishermen Simon and Andrew what He will make them. What is it?
At once, Simon and Andrew leave their ___ and follow Jesus.

cards.text: AT ONCE. Friend, I hit snooze three times just to get out of bed, and these two drop their nets on the spot.
Jesus goes a little farther and spots two more brothers: James and John, the sons of Zebedee. Not John the Baptist, friend. A different John.

cards.question: When Jesus spots James and John, the sons of Zebedee, what are they doing?

answers.text: Mending their nets in a boat

cards.question: Jesus waits a while before calling James and John to follow Him.
When James and John follow Jesus, they leave their father Zebedee all alone in the boat.

cards.text: So Zebedee stays in the boat with the hired men, and his sons follow Jesus. I bet he's sitting there holding a half-mended net going, "Okay. So THIS one's mine now."

findings.problem: Stop 1, card 3 quotes "The time is fulfilled.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: Stop 1, card 8 quotes "Come, follow Me.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: The card states a Bible fact from outside the passage, that people went out to the Jordan River to see John (Mark 1:5), but cites only Mark 1:14. It also stretches Mark 1:5 ('The whole region of Judea and all the people of Jerusalem') to 'everybody.'

rule.text: References. Every Bible fact he states carries its reference.

findings.problem: "Has just been arrested" adds a time the text doesn't give. Mark 1:14 says only "After the arrest of John."

rule.text: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.

findings.problem: The blank asks the baker to fill in the next word of Jesus' line ("repent and ___ in the gospel"), wording no earlier card has shown. No story card sets up the call to repent and believe.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.
